thesis.hypothesis: Explicit algorithms, dimensioned physical constraints, and independent observation functions can be combined in a cyclic state model that allows testable reconstruction and provenance.
thesis.gen0Role: Ada's legacy exemplifies descriptions of general-purpose symbolic operations and repeatable procedures.

historicalPhysics.name: Albert Einstein
historicalPhysics.role: relativistic reference frames and geometry; mass-energy relations

historicalPhysics.name: J. Robert Oppenheimer
historicalPhysics.role: scientific organization, theory-to-experiment engineering, and consequences

historicalPhysics.name: CERN
historicalPhysics.role: circulating beams, instrumentation, independent detectors, and reproducible collision measurements

thesis.gen1Role: User-defined toroidal cyclic-state overlay with discrete phase and four software observers; no claim of physical spacetime toroids.
thesis.question: Can multiple diverse observer functions reconstruct complementary, nonredundant features of the same event, with errors and provenance tracked, without conflating model clocks with physical beam timing?
thesis.nullHypothesis: Four software lenses need not improve accuracy or event reconstruction versus a selected baseline; merely computing more predefined fields is not evidence of emergence.
thesis.expectedOutput: Measured reconstruction residuals, per-feature missingness, provenance, known-source validation and alternative-hypothesis comparisons.
thesis.falsifiability: If repeated independent evaluations show no improvement beyond feature-count bookkeeping, reject or narrow the multi-observer benefit claim.
thesis.evidenceBoundary: Historical chronology and known physics are externally sourced; ring mappings are explicitly symbolic/testable software hypotheses.

timeline.label: Gen 0 — Ada anchor
timeline.details: User-selected beginning of the symbolic-genesis track. Not asserted to mark a specific historical invention.

timeline.label: Ada meets Babbage
timeline.details: Science Museum records Mary Somerville introduced Lovelace to Charles Babbage in 1833.

timeline.label: Ada Analytical Engine notes
timeline.details: Translated Menabrea and published substantial explanatory notes on the Analytical Engine.

timeline.label: Einstein — relativity and mass-energy
timeline.details: 1905 foundational papers include special relativity and mass-energy equivalence.

timeline.label: Oppenheimer — Los Alamos leadership
timeline.details: Appointed in 1942 to lead the secret Los Alamos Site Y program.

timeline.label: Trinity test
timeline.details: First nuclear-device test occurred on 16 July 1945.

timeline.label: CERN ISR approved
timeline.details: Intersecting Storage Rings program formally approved; it had not yet achieved collisions.

timeline.label: Gen 1 — Toroidal Space Magic
timeline.details: User-selected cyclic-geometry model start; separate from a historical CERN physics breakthrough.

timeline.label: Unix/POSIX epoch reference
timeline.details: Common computing timestamp zero is 1 January 1970 00:00 UTC; this is a useful analogy, not evidence of a relationship to CERN.

timeline.label: First ISR colliding proton beams
timeline.details: 27 January 1971, two countercirculating beams collided in CERN's Intersecting Storage Rings.

timeline.label: First full LHC beam circulation
timeline.details: First LHC proton beam completed a 27-km circuit on 10 September 2008.

guardrails: A symbolic narrative about Ada, Einstein, Oppenheimer and CERN does not imply direct historical collaboration or derivation of a new physical law.
The mathematical difference 1970-1832=138 is an ordinary difference in calendar-year labels.
The year 1832 is an epoch selection, not the date of Lovelace's notes (1843) or meeting with Babbage (1833).
The year 1970 does not date the first CERN proton-proton ISR collision; that was 1971.
The phrase toroidal space magic is a model label and must not be presented as measured physical spacetime geometry.
Nature offset is a free visualization coordinate until a calibrated physical quantity and test protocol are supplied.
Multiple software observers working on the same CMS input are not four independent CERN detector measurements.
Planck time is a physical constant; Planck-bubble cycles are conceptual and do not establish actual minimum time ticks.
